design.question: On the drug discovery preset, with every kind of agent and money following earnings, which of the six rule settings gets furthest?
design.compare: Traditional, OSO (immediate), OSO (choice), Flow-back, finished-only, No flow-back, immediate, No flow-back, choice
design.measure: all of hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, money to the main level, waste

answer: Best overall: OSO. Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, money to the main level and waste. (6 measures; a clear difference is more than 2.6 standard errors.)
answers: hardest level: 6.00 against traditional 2.88, clearly better.
targets solved: 2.75 against traditional 0.65, clearly better.
bounty value: 1337 against traditional 316, clearly better.
money to the main level: 654 against traditional 1039, clearly better.
caveats: A simulation with guessed parameters: it shows how the rules play out, not that they work.
